Title: Azure Virtual Machines DCsv2-series are now available in Canada East

Body.Content:
Confidential computing DCsv2-series virtual machines (VMs) are now available in Canada East. Customers now have disaster recovery capabilities with Canada East and Canada Central. Easily deploy today.

These VMs are backed by the latest generation of Intel XEON E-2288G processor with Software Guard Extensions (SGX) technology, and with the Intel Turbo Boost Technology these machines can go up to 5.0 GHz. Use the DCsv2-series instances to build secure, enclave-based applications to protect your code and data while it’s in use.

Learn more about Disaster Recovery

See the latest regional availability for all Azure Virtual Machines

Read more about Azure confidential computing
